jobs.title: Data Platform Delivery and Operations - Supervising Associate
jobs.description: Location: Dallas, Akron, Alpharetta, Arlington, Atlanta, Baltimore, Boca Raton, Boston, Buffalo, Charleston, Charlotte, Chattanooga, Cincinnati, Cleveland, Detroit, Grand Rapids, Grandview Heights, Greenville, Hartford, Hoboken, Indianapolis, Iselin, Jacksonville, Jericho, Louisville, Manayunk, McLean, Miami, New York, Orlando, Philadelphia, Pittsburgh, Providence, Raleigh, Richmond, Rochester, Stamford, Tallahassee, Tampa, Toledo, Washington, Austin, Baton Rouge, Birmingham, Chicago, Des Moines, Fort Worth, Houston, Huntsville, Jackson, Kansas City, Memphis, Milwaukee, Minneapolis, Nashville, New Orleans, Oklahoma City, Rogers, San Antonio, St. Louis, Tulsa, Wichita At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. The opportunity As a Supervising Associate - Data Delivery & Operations, you'll have the opportunity to help shape the future of enterprise data, analytics and AI solutions. Working alongside talented engineering teams and business stakeholders, you'll design, build and support modern data platforms, advanced analytics capabilities and AI-powered solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. This role offers a unique opportunity to work hands-on with emerging AI technologies, including the development and deployment of intelligent agents, generative AI solutions and cloud-based platforms. You'll collaborate directly with internal teams and stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions while helping advance our AI and data capabilities. If you're passionate about data engineering, AI innovation and solving complex business challenges, this role provides the opportunity to make a tangible impact while helping lead the evolution of AI agent architecture, automation and enterprise analytics. Your Key Responsibilities Execute and coordinate assigned technical work across the design, development, testing, deployment and production support of enterprise data solutions. Manage defined technical deliverables and workstreams, escalating risks, dependencies and decisions to the Assistant Director when required. Investigate technical and production issues, perform root-cause analysis and coordinate fixes with development, testing and business teams. Review code, configurations, data models, data pipelines, business logic and technical documentation for completeness, accuracy and adherence to established standards. Translate stakeholder requirements into clear technical tasks, acceptance criteria and delivery plans. Support quality-assurance and user-acceptance testing, including test-case preparation, defect investigation, resolution tracking and validation of completed fixes. Produce and maintain technical specifications, process documentation, operating procedures, support guides and knowledge-transfer materials. Provide day-to-day technical guidance, share leading practices, support less-experienced colleagues and promote consistent development, testing and documentation standards. Support onshore and offshore transitions through structured knowledge transfer, technical and operational handovers, dependency tracking and post-transition stabilization. Coordinate across geographies and time zones to ensure technical issues are assigned, tracked and resolved. Skills And Attributes For Success Strong data-engineering knowledge across data ingestion and integration, transformation and orchestration, data modelling, data quality and reconciliation, testing and validation, monitoring, issue management, deployment and production support. Ability to review technical designs and work products, identify issues and recommend practical improvements. Ability to provide technical guidance while operating effectively as an individual contributor. Collaborative approach, with a willingness to share knowledge, mentor colleagues, resolve issues and provide constructive feedback. Sound judgment in identifying matters that require architectural, strategic or stakeholder decisions and escalating them promptly. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues, risks and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to collaborate effectively with onshore and offshore teams while maintaining clear ownership, communication and follow-through. To qualify for the role, you must have A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or an equivalent technology-related discipline, such as Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Applied Mathematics or another quantitative field with a significant computing component. 2-5 years of progressive professional experience in data engineering, data platforms, analytics engineering, business intelligence or related technology-delivery roles. Hands-on experience developing or supporting data and analytics solutions using Azure Databricks and/or Microsoft Fabric, with experience in at least one of these platforms required. Experience building, maintaining or troubleshooting data pipelines and integrations across multiple systems and data sources. Experience supporting the design, development, testing, deployment and production operation of enterprise data solutions. Experience independently managing defined technical deliverables or workstreams. Experience investigating technical issues, performing root-cause analysis and coordinating fixes. Experience reviewing technical outputs, data pipelines, business logic and supporting documentation. Experience supporting testing activities and maintaining technical and operational documentation. Experience supporting onshore/offshore transitions, knowledge transfer, handovers and stabilization. Ideally, you'll also have Experience with Azure AI Foundry. Experience designing, creating, configuring or supporting AI and data agents using Databricks Genie, Microsoft Fabric Data Agents or comparable agent-based technologies. Experience implementing generative AI, natural-language analytics, conversational data experiences or AI-enabled business insights. Experience with Power BI, semantic models, DAX, Power Query or related Microsoft analytics technologies. Relevant Microsoft Azure, Databricks or Microsoft Fabric certifications. What We Offer You At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers. We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is: New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $104,600 to $177,900 Bay Area California offices – $109,000 to $185,300 All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $87,200 to $163,000 Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options. Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being. Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today. To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period. EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis. For those living in California, please click here for additional information. At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment. EY | Building a better working world EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets. Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow. EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories. All in to shape the future with confidence. EY provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, genetic information, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected basis, including arrest and conviction records, in accordance with applicable law. EY is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities including veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and either need assistance applying online or need to request an accommodation during any part of the application process, please call 1-800-EY-HELP3, select Option 2 for candidate related inquiries, then select Option 1 for candidate queries and finally select Option 2 for candidates with an inquiry which will route you to EY’s Talent Shared Services Team (TSS) or email the TSS at ssc.customersupport@ey.com.

jobs.title: Security Data Engineer
jobs.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About The Role Claude is trained and served on hardware in data centers Anthropic operates and in sites partners build and run for us. DCSE secures that footprint: the sites, the hardware moving through them, and the people and vendors who touch it. Security at that scale runs on data, and you'll be the engineer who owns it and the systems that produce it: component-level hardware inventory and chain of custody, fed by software that runs at our sites and on hosts, and continuous control monitoring, with the posture calculations that decide what each site is cleared to run. You set the architecture, agree schemas and interfaces with the teams, operators and vendors that own the sources, build the pipelines, stores and tools, and run what you ship. The goal is security that runs itself: custody, access and evidence verified continuously from records, with tools and AI agents doing the reviews. We favor simple, standard controls and tools that can be verified over elaborate ones. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well. You'll work with the rest of DCSE, including the engineers on its security monitoring platform, with Anthropic's compute and data center operations teams, and directly with data center operators, hardware vendors and logistics providers. The role is based in San Francisco, with remote applicants in the US considered, and involves regular travel to data center sites, which are critical infrastructure. Key Responsibilities Hardware inventory and chain of custody: own the component-level record of what hardware exists, where it is and who has handled it: the data model, the pipelines that join inventory and custody events from many source systems, change history on every record, and the tamper-evident stores behind it Tools, automation and AI agents: build the tools and agents the team runs on this data: reconciliation, audit evidence exports, custody checks. When a review keeps costing people time, you build the tool or agent that retires it Custody workflows and field software: build the workflows and the site and host software that capture custody events as they happen (a receipt, a move, a data wipe, a decommission) and enforce who is authorized to record them Continuous control monitoring and posture: own the pipelines that turn check outcomes, assessment results and findings into per-control and per-site measures over time, against the compliance frameworks we and our partners are assessed against, and the posture calculation that decides what a site is cleared to run Data quality: build coverage checks, reconciliation against sources and alerts on a silent or drifting feed, so a wrong or missing record is caught the same day; own retention and access controls on the records Integration and reporting: agree schemas and interfaces with the engineers who run the security monitoring platform, and build the query surfaces and reports the team, site leads and leadership use directly Minimum Qualifications Have designed and run production data systems (relational schemas, change data capture, batch or streaming pipelines and the services around them) and kept them correct: coverage measured, records reconciled against the source, alerts on silence, and a design that expects records to get corrupted or lost Have integrated with systems you did not control (inventory tools, ticketing systems, vendor APIs) and built data models that outlive any one source Have shipped software that runs outside a central service (host agents, site-local services, edge collectors) and kept it correct in the field, or built metrics a team made decisions on and defended them when challenged Have worked hands-on with data about physical assets or security controls: a hardware fleet, data center or supply chain inventory, asset custody, or the control and evidence data of a security or compliance program Read and review other people's code, and build with AI coding agents using Git and code review Own a domain end to end: set the approach, design and build it with the teams and vendors whose systems it depends on, and run it as something people use every day Write SQL and at least one general-purpose programming language well Preferred Qualifications Experience with asset management, supply chain or warehouse systems where serialized tracking and custody transfer are the core problem Experience building continuous control monitoring or metrics for a security or compliance program, or producing evidence an assessor accepted, for example against NIST SP 800-53, ISO 27001 or SOC 2 Experience with risk or posture scoring that combines control results, findings and other evidence into a measure people make decisions on Familiarity with data center hardware and its lifecycle from receipt to decommission, and with sites and parties you did not control: colocation, cloud or GPU cloud operators, hardware manufacturers, logistics providers Have run software on many hosts or at remote sites with versioned rollout and a way to know each copy is still reporting Have built AI agents or automation that replaced recurring manual work The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary $320,000—$405,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How We're Different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: General Summary Reporting to the Director of Information Technology, this position will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining scalable ingestion frameworks across modern data tools. The ideal candidate should be highly motivated and passionate about creating data pipelines and models to help solve real-world business problems and should have experience working with cloud-based data platforms. Supervisory Responsibilities General Requirements: This position has no supervisory responsibilities. All duties performed will be done accurately and in a timely manner. Design, build, and maintain data pipelines and models for business users. Extract data from various sources using data replication tools and APIs. Scale and optimize exiting data pipelines to ensure efficient data flow and availability. Use data transformation and management tools to ensure high-quality, reproducible, and scalable data models. Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to understand data needs and implement data models to support business intelligence tools and analytics. Ensure data integrity, accuracy, and quality across all data-related projects. Continuously evaluate and recommend improvements to the data architecture and tools used within the company. Knowledge, Skills And Abilities Strong experience with Snowflake for data warehousing and managing large datasets. Proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server for querying, data manipulation, and optimization. Experience in Azure or equivalent cloud platform. Strong SQL skills and solid foundation in Python. Proficiency in dbt (or similar) for data transformation, testing, and documentation. Experience in version control (such as Azure DevOps) and collaborative coding workflows. Experience with data replication tools such as Fivetran, Snowflake Openflow or similar replication software. Ability to work on a team and be proficient in collaborating with product owners and development teams. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with limited supervision. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Detail-oriented with a strong understanding of incremental logic, schema evolution, and data quality testing.

jobs.title: VIE - Data Engineer (H/F) - New York
jobs.description: CONTEXTE ET MISSION Hermès déploie aux États-Unis une Data Platform cloud de nouvelle génération. Vous en serez l'un des premiers ingénieurs à en poser les fondations techniques sur le terrain. Hermès engage une migration de ses plateformes data locales. Le ou la VIE aux États-Unis prendra en charge les chantiers d'ingénierie data liés à cette transformation. Vous ne rejoignez pas un projet en phase de maintenance. Vous formerez également un binôme opérationnel avec le ou la VIE Data Analyst présent(e) sur le même programme : l'un construit les fondations, l'autre les valorise, les deux rôles sont indissociables. Ce poste s'adresse à un profil rigoureux et structuré, qui sait construire des solutions solides et pérennes. Dans un programme de migration à fort enjeu, la qualité et la traçabilité des livrables priment sur la vitesse d'exécution. RESPONSABILITÉS PRINCIPALES Relais standards & bonnes pratiques Agir en tant que relais local des patterns d'architecture, méthodologies, standards et bonnes pratiques définis et en garantir l'adoption et le respect dans l'ensemble des développements menés. Pipeline & ingestion Concevoir et développer les pipelines de données depuis les sources locales US vers Snowflake (dbt, SQL). Assurer la qualité, la fiabilité et la traçabilité des flux de données : tests, documentation, versioning GitLab CI/CD. Participer à l'évolution du schéma de la Data Platform en lien avec les équipes Data & AI Platform. S’inscrire dans le respect du core model retail déjà déployé sur d’autres plaques géographiques Modélisation & datamarts Modéliser les datamarts métier en conformité avec les data models cibles définis par la direction. Structurer les couches de transformation selon les standards dbt et les conventions Hermès. Documenter les modèles et contribuer au catalogue de données : descriptions, lineage, tests de conformité. Migration & cohérence Cartographier les sources de données existantes sur les plateformes locales et établir leur correspondance avec les nouveaux modèles. Identifier et traiter les écarts de définition ou de grain entre systèmes sources et cibles. PROFIL RECHERCHÉ Diplôme Bac+5 en informatique, data engineering, mathématiques appliquées ou équivalent Première expérience significative (stage longue durée, alternance ou première mission) en data engineering ou analytics engineering SQL avancé et bonnes pratiques de modélisation relationnelle (Star/Snowflake schema) dbt (Core ou Cloud) : modèles, tests, documentation, macros Snowflake ou équivalent cloud data warehouse (BigQuery, Redshift) GitLab CI/CD : le versioning et pratiques d'intégration continue La connaissance de Power BI ou d'un outil de BI est un plus. Rigueur, aisance oral, proactivité Aisance en anglais professionnel (écrit et oral) indispensable ; le français est un atout. CE QUE VOUS Y TROUVEREZ Une immersion dans un environnement data moderne sur un cas réel, à l'échelle d'une maison de luxe internationale. Un binôme opérationnel avec un(e) VIE Data Analyst sur le même programme : vous construisez les fondations, il ou elle les valorise. Une collaboration structurante dès le premier jour. Une collaboration directe avec des équipes data et métier dans un contexte international Paris / US, avec une exposition forte aux deux cultures de travail. Basé(e) aux États-Unis, vous évoluez dans un environnement à culture entrepreneuriale forte : autonomie réelle, interlocuteurs directs, décisions rapides. On attend de vous que vous preniez des positions, pas que vous attendiez des validations. Merci de vérifier que vous remplissez les conditions du V.I.E avant de postuler à l’offre d’emploi. Vous pouvez être volontaire si vous remplissez les 5 conditions suivantes : Avoir entre 18 et 28 ans à la date de l'inscription. Le départ en mission s'effectue au plus tard le jour du 29e anniversaire. Au-delà, aucune dérogation n'est accordée. jobs.title: Autonomous Vehicle Data Analyst Engineer
jobs.description: Position Overview Join International Motors in Advancing Autonomous Vehicle Technology at our Advanced Technology Center in Elmendorf, TX just outside of San Antonio. International Motors is seeking an Autonomous Vehicle Data Analyst Engineer to support the development and validation of next-generation autonomous vehicle systems. This role is part of the Autonomous Vehicle (AV) On-Road Long Term Test group and offers the opportunity to contribute to the advancement of Level 3 and Level 4 autonomous driving technology through real-world, over-the-road testing and validation. Reporting to the Senior Engineering Manager, you will work collaboratively with an engineering team and AV safety driver to support ongoing development and validation activities, helping advance autonomous vehicle performance and reliability. This position offers flexibility to work day or night shifts, providing the opportunity to support testing and validation activities across different operating schedules. Travel Requirements: Regular travel to International Proving Grounds (IPG) in New Carlisle, Indiana, as well as occasional business travel for training up to 50%. Join International Motors and contribute to the future of autonomous vehicle innovation. Responsibilities Taking ownership of the test article and taking responsibility for ensuring the vehicle’s road readiness and data acquisition equipment for over the road testing, needing to rotate to 2nd shift testing. Inform the safety driver of the ADS behavior communicating and participate in daily over the road testing of the AV systems with the AV safety driver, requesting him to take over when facing possible unsafe operations, if needed. Document, tag, upload and process the data and analyze driving events with AV development team Troubleshoot when the AV is not in Active Automated mode and at Standstill Attend training on site at OEM and Navistar test locations, as needed. Minimum Requirements Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology or Computer Science Additional Requirements Qualified candidates, excluding current employees, must be legally authorized on an unrestricted basis (US Citizen, Legal Permanent Resident, Refugee or Asylee) to be employed in the United States. We do not anticipate providing employment related work sponsorship for this position (e.g., H-1B status) Desired Skills Proven organizational skills for planning and documentation of daily missions to safety drivers. Prior powertrain calibration / data acquisition experience on mobile platforms in automotive / commercial truck industry. Excellent communication skills with reconstructing events during over the road testing both in presentations and verbal communications to all parties involved with the testing. Experience with uploading of large data files, data analysis and triaging fault codes in vehicle or other mobile platforms. Experience and / or understanding of with automotive / commercial platforms maintenance procedures. Working knowledge of automotive / Commercial truck powertrain platforms Working knowledge or experience with automotive / Commercial truck ADAS systems Fluency in all Microsoft Office Applications; Excel, Word, PowerPoint for documentation and communications of trip planning and debriefing. Ability to work in a team environment for prolonged periods of testing, with AV safety drivers over the road. Benefits And Compensation This position offers competitive market-based compensation, along with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employee wellbeing. You can learn more about the benefits offered for this position by visiting https://careers.international.com/#benefits. The expected salary offered for this position will fall within the stated range, with the final offer based on the candidates' applicable skills, knowledge, and experience. Company Overview About TRATON With its brands Scania, MAN, International, and Volkswagen Truck & Bus, TRATON SE is the parent and holding company of the TRATON GROUP and one of the world’s leading commercial vehicle manufacturers. The Group’s product portfolio comprises trucks, buses, and light-duty commercial vehicles. “Transforming Transportation Together. For a sustainable world.”: this intention underlines the Company’s ambition to have a lasting and sustainable impact on the commercial vehicle business and on the Group’s commercial growth. About International From a one-man company built on the world-changing invention of the McCormick reaper in 1831, to the 15,000-person-strong company we are today, few companies can lay claim to a history like International. Based in Lisle, Illinois, International Motors, LLC* creates solutions that deliver greater uptime and productivity to our customers throughout the full operation of our commercial vehicles. We build International® trucks and engines and IC Bus® school and commercial buses that are as tough and as smart as the people who drive them. We also develop Fleetrite® aftermarket parts. In everything we do, our vision is to accelerate the impact of sustainable mobility to create the cleaner, safer world we all deserve. As of 2021, we joined Scania, MAN and Volkswagen Truck & Bus in TRATON GROUP, a global champion of the truck and transport services industry. To learn more, visit International.com. International Motors, LLC is d/b/a International Motors USA in Illinois, Missouri, New Jersey, Ohio, Texas, and Utah. EEO Statement We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics. jobs.title: Data Engineer, Video Platform
jobs.description: Responsibilities About the team: TikTok video system is a world-leading video platform that provides multi-media storage, delivery, transcoding services. As a part of US Tech Service department, we are responsible for building the next generation video processing platform which provides excellent experiences for billions of users around the world. About the role: As a Data Engineer, you will be instrumental in shaping strategic decisions within the Video Architecture Platform. This role emphasizes building, optimizing, and maintaining robust data processing architectures that support new data and ETL pipelines. Your expertise will ensure that data flows reliably and accurately across various systems, empowering stakeholders with high-quality, actionable insights that impact quality of service, quality of experience and cost optimizations. Responsibilities: - Craft optimal end to end data processing architecture and systems for new data and ETL pipelines. - Design, build, and maintain efficient and reliable data pipelines to move and transform big data. - Implement and monitor quality control measures to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and consistency. - Drive internal process improvements and automate manual processes for data quality and SLA management. - Create and maintain technical documentation, such as data dictionaries, data flow diagrams, and system documentation, to ensure efficient and effective data management and analysis. - Work closely with data engineering and various vertical teams within the Video Architecture platform and cross-functional teams within USDS. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications: - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical background involving software/system engineering, or equivalent working experience. - Good programming experience with SQL and at least one of the following languages: Java, Python, Go, or Scala. - Experience in data analytics and data engineering ETL development, data pipeline design, implementation, and maintenance. - Experience with big data ecosystem suing Spark, Flink, Hive, YARN, Kafka. Preferred Qualifications: - Demonstrated independent thinking capabilities and troubleshooting skills in large scale distributed systems. - Good communication and coordination skills. - Experience in building data solutions with AWS, GCP, Azure and other cloud services is a plus. About USDS TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale.​ ​ On-site presence across teams allows the company to operate with greater speed, alignment, and agility — especially in areas like real-time decision-making, team development, and integrated execution. As such, the company is shifting from a hybrid work model to a fully in-person schedule up to 5 days a week.​ Why Join Us Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​ We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​ ​ Diversity & Inclusion​ TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​ USDS Reasonable Accommodation USDS is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/USDS-RA​ Job Information 【For Pay Transparency】Compensation Description (Annually) The base salary range for this position in the selected city is $129960 - $246240 annually.​ Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.​ Benefits may vary depending on the nature of employment and the country work location. Employees have day one access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) savings plan with company match, paid parental leave, short-term and long-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits, among others. Employees also receive 10 paid holidays per year, 10 paid sick days per year and 17 days of Paid Personal Time (prorated upon hire with increasing accruals by tenure).​ The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice.​ For Los Angeles County (unincorporated) Candidates:​ Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Our company believes that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship on the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment:​ 1. Interacting and occasionally having unsupervised contact with internal/external clients and/or colleagues;​ 2. Appropriately handling and managing confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information and access to information technology systems; and​ 3. Exercising sound judgment.​
